newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar output seen at 4.20 mln T in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: German sugar output seen at 4.20 mln T in 1996/97.

text.p: German domestic sugar production in the 1996/97 (October/September) season is forecast at 4.20 million tonnes compared with 3.83 million in 1995/96, the sugar industry association WVZ said on Monday.
WVZ said in a statement the higher 1996/97 output figure would be the result of higher sugar content, which at 18.17 percent was up from 16.73 percent in 1995/96, more than offseting a lower area.
The sugar beet area in 1996/97 was 514,452 hectares, down 0.6 percent from 1995/96.
WVZ maintained an area forecast for the upcoming 1997/98 campaign at 508,687 ha, although the ZMP farm price office earlier this month said the area should be 510,968 ha.
WVZ said exports and imports should be significantly higher than the 1.15 million tonnes and 140,330 tonnes respectively recorded in 1995/96.
October/April 1996/97 exports totalled 969,642 tonnes and cumulative imports stood at 46,982, WVZ data showed.
